content:
The console is the simplest way to tag a collection.
To create a tag (console)
1.
Sign in to the Amazon OpenSearch Service console at https://console.aws.amazon.com/aos/
home.
2.
Expand Serverless in the left navigation pane and choose Collections.
3.
Select the collection that you want to add tags to, and go to the Tags tab.
4.
Choose Manage and Add new tag.
5.
Enter a tag key and an optional value.
6.
Choose Save.
To delete a tag, follow the same steps and choose Remove on the Manage tags page.
For more information about using the console to work with tags, see Tag Editor in the AWS
Management Console Getting Started Guide.
